description: This file defines the class BaseUnvoidHandler, which implements logic for unvoiding objects that implement the Voidable interface within the OpenMRS framework. It contains a handle() method that resets voided status and related metadata for such objects, intended to be used around methods that perform unvoiding operations.

classes.name: BaseUnvoidHandler
classes.description: A handler class that provides the logic to unvoid objects implementing the Voidable interface by resetting their voided status and related metadata.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the unvoiding process by checking if the object is voided and if the voiding date matches the expected, then resets the voided status and associated data.
